mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, wallet_id AS walletId, linked_account_id AS linkedAccountId, amount AS amount, mock_bank_transaction_id AS mockBankTransactionId, status AS status FROM withdrawal_requests WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdrawal_requests (user_id, wallet_id, linked_account_id, amount, idempotency_key, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{walletId}, #{linkedAccountId}, #{amount}, #{idempotencyKey}, 'READY')
mapper.update: UPDATE withdrawal_requests SET mock_bank_transaction_id = #{bankTransactionId}, status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY'
